name: Alien – Visiting, Not Impressed
title: Alien – Visiting, Not Impressed Ornament
story: This alien ornament is for the person who treats every party like a stop on a very disappointing tour: an alien with crossed arms leaning on its flying saucer, and an easy Christmas stocking gift for a sci-fi fan, a sarcastic friend or a teenager.

The print is a gray-green alien in orange sneakers and striped socks, arms crossed, leaning on a patched-up saucer beside a desert shack and a cactus, under VISITING. in gold and NOT IMPRESSED. in cream slab capitals, on a deep night-blue disc. The art matches our Visiting, Not Impressed oversized hoodie, so the ornament makes a set with the hoodie.

Everyone knows someone who shows up, looks around and gives the whole planet a flat review. The ornament says it in three words and one unimpressed visitor. Hang it on a sturdy branch, tuck it into a stocking, or tie it to a gift for the person who would rather be on the mothership. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.
joke_a: An alien crosses the galaxy and the review is two words long: not impressed. The Visiting, Not Impressed ornament from Graphic Tees Co. prints a sulking alien leaning on its saucer, so any sarcastic friend or sci-fi fan gets the joke on the tree at a glance.
